items.label: Profile
items.content: A senior marketing strategist with a background in blending technology, data, and creativity to drive strong results for teams across B2B SaaS, beauty, entertainment, and advanced tech. Through my own micro-agency, I've led end-to-end marketing function builds for clients, working closely with sales and product teams to tie marketing directly to revenue and pipeline.

jobs.title: Partner & Studio Lead
bullets: Run a marketing consultancy serving service and consumer brands, owning client strategy, multi-channel campaigns, delivery, and the client relationship.

jobs.org: Fabutan, Canada's Largest Tanning Chain (90+ locations)
jobs.title: Senior Marketing Advisor
bullets: Owned strategy for a 90+ location consumer brand, rebuilding paid and organic media, creative, and attribution and cutting tracked acquisition cost from $72 to $22.
Built a custom ad management platform that cut time to publish Meta and Google ads across 90 locations by 60%+, and created executive reporting that tied spend to outcomes.

jobs.title: Fractional Marketing & Brand Lead
bullets: Led go-to-market strategy for a VR EdTech startup, helping take their team from concept to a successful seed raise (~$1.2M valuation) in 6 months.
Created brand design and web presence, built customer interview system and developed a core messaging document, set up the CRM and trained junior sales staff on outbound sales motion.
Branding and messaging work went on to be used in partnership with the International Space Station Laboratory.

jobs.title: Fractional Delivery Lead
bullets: Fractional engagement to build and run an immersive-technology product development department, owning scoping, staffing, project management, and client communication across concurrent projects.
Deliver multiple initiatives on time and on budget while managing stakeholder expectations throughout.
Project clients included NAIT, the City of Calgary, Edmonton Chinatown Association, and the Alberta Sports Hall of Fame.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
bullets: Rebuilt Google Ads tracking, targeting, and reporting, raising ROAS from 3.6x to 5.8x in 3 months.
Aligned marketing with sales by shifting reporting from top-of-funnel leads to booked and completed jobs via a custom ServiceTitan CRM integration.

jobs.org: VRKADE, Western Canada's Largest VR Arcade Chain
jobs.title: Senior Marketing Lead
bullets: Led full-funnel paid media across Meta and Google, cutting customer acquisition cost from $85 to $17.
Led a full rebrand and content overhaul and landed a national mall partnership driving $100k/year in incremental profit.

jobs.org: The Winston, Calgary Premium Golf Course
jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
bullets: Ran paid media and email funnels to acquire leads for $30k memberships, cutting cost per qualified lead from $640 to $343 over 6 months.

jobs.title: Growth & Content Lead
bullets: Grew a media audience by 50,000+ followers and 30,000+ email subscribers through organic social, content, and email strategy.

jobs.title: GTM & Paid Advertising Lead
bullets: Built the go-to-market, PPC, and attribution framework for a B2B AI SaaS team, testing campaigns across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn.

header.name: Brayden Clark
header.title: Digital Marketing Strategist · Performance & Growth · Multi-Channel Campaigns

body: I started my career marketing entertainment brands, but I quickly moved into building full marketing systems for startups. Those startups needed product help, so I dug into JavaScript to better understand their problems.

One thing led to another, and eight years later I've found myself leading development teams, heading up product development for clients like NAIT and the City of Calgary, and overhauling entire marketing stacks for clients like Fabutan.

So I've done the entire stack: from building the products, to branding them, and managing the PPC behind them. Because of that I have a deep sense of how to tie marketing to product, sales, and ultimately revenue. I know how to sit with CEOs and shareholders, and know how to lead teams of employees and contractors.

I've worked alongside former POD members before, and they've had nothing but great things to say about the team. While I've run my own studio for a long time, I want to bring the skillset I've built to a larger team where I can take on more impactful projects. From what I've heard, POD is a great place to do that.
I thrive on that level of ownership and problem solving, and it seems like that is exactly what you're looking for at POD. I'd love to bring my unique blend of marketing talents to your team.
